Q10. Which storage device has the largest capacity typically?

Q15. 1 Yottabyte (YB) is equal to:

Section 3: Concepts of Software (Questions 31 to 55)

Q31. Which of the following is NOT a system software?

A) Operating System B) Compiler C) Antivirus ✅ (Utility software, but can be considered system software too... let's make it clear)

Actually, antivirus is often classified as utility software. But if we need to pick one that is clearly NOT system software: A better option: Which of the following is application software? A) Windows B) Linux C) MS Word ✅ D) BIOS

Let's redo Q31:

Q31. Which of the following is application software?

A) Windows 10 B) Linux C) MS Word ✅ D) BIOS

Q32. What is the role of the operating system in memory management?

A) Allocates memory to programs ✅ B) Creates documents C) Plays games D) Designs graphics

Q33. Which of the following is an example of a multi-user operating system?

A) Windows 10 Home B) MS-DOS C) UNIX ✅ D) Windows 7 Home

Q34. What does a compiler produce?

A) Source code B) Object code ✅ C) Executable code D) Pseudo-code

A) Compilation converts entire program, interpretation converts line by line ✅ B) Interpretation converts entire program, compilation converts line by line C) Both are the same D) Compilation is faster than interpretation

Q36. Which translator converts assembly code to machine code?

A) Compiler B) Interpreter C) Assembler ✅ D) Loader

Q37. What is the function of a linker in the compilation process?

A) Translates source code B) Combines object files ✅ C) Loads programs into memory D) Executes programs

Q38. What is the function of a loader?

A) Translates source code B) Combines object files C) Loads executable program into memory ✅ D) Manages memory

Q42. What is the advantage of time-sharing?

Q46. Which Linux command displays the system date and time?

Q47. Which Linux command is used to clear the terminal screen?
